Agent 06/35 — keyboard driver intent in rapid chicanes. Build deterministic 60–120 km/h alternating A/D sequences representing realistic S-bends and quick corrections. Measure command, actual rack, yaw phase lag, slip, lateral G and whether the emergency path accidentally triggers. Improve only the digital input model; no tire/chassis masking. Ensure release/reversal feels responsive while ordinary chicane steering remains inside useful tire slip.
